name: Mateo Sepúlveda
bio:
Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Santiago, where he spent weekends at local karting events. He pursued a degree in journalism, specializing in sports communication, and quickly made a name for himself covering national rally championships. His sharp writing and knack for uncovering compelling human-interest stories caught the attention of Nostalgia Racing, who headhunted him to manage their public image.

As a PR officer, Mateo is known for his relentless pursuit of positive press coverage and his unwavering commitment to crafting narratives that resonate with fans. He's a firm believer in transparency and authenticity, often pushing the team to engage directly with their audience. While some find his demanding nature challenging, his colleagues acknowledge that his dedication stems from a deep-seated desire to see Nostalgia Racing succeed, both on and off the track. He's committed to making the team a household name in the racing world.

What sets Mateo apart is his ability to blend traditional media relations with cutting-edge digital strategies. He is constantly exploring new avenues to engage with fans, from interactive social media campaigns to virtual reality experiences, ensuring that Nostalgia Racing remains at the forefront of motorsport innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Mateo has a lean build and a sharp, intense gaze that conveys his unwavering focus.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of pacing while on phone calls, often wearing a groove in the office carpet.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief motivational speech.
